protocol.purpose: Frozen observed-rainfall development benchmark with paired r39 controls, common footprints and initial-state uncertainty

analysis_protocol.reference: WorldClim2.1 1970–2000 monthly rainfall normals already in the canonical r39 Earth cases, used only for scoring. No observed winds/humidity or rainfall field forces prototype integrations. Simulated lateral states inherit their old-model climatological backgrounds; this is a conditional regional test.

Solar orbit period365.2422days retained. r39 raw25-step year reaggregated by existing Gregorian interval-overlap routine, not by reusing equal-month saved totals. Evaluation cumulative runrain atday45 minusday14, divided31 for meanrate.

ExtraMexicowet450s is numerical sensitivity only, excludedfromprimarymean. Mexico selectedbecause priorfourpartday1rain spatialstepRMSwaslargest ofthree.
analysis_protocol.footprints: Exact centered projected224km footprints over56km r39/referencecells, with halfwidth finepixels at boundaries. Area=56²km²/projectionJacobian. Reference validarea requiresinmap/land/finiteallmonthlyrain. Primarycoarsecentersmustbeinmap/land,excludeonecoarseboundarycellandhave>=80percentvalidlandarea. Same mask/areas forr39 andallprototypebranches; no implicitmissingcellfilter or replacementmask. ReporteligibleN/areas andsecondarycenterlandcoverage. No terrain elevation mask inprimary.
analysis_protocol.primary_score: AreaweightedMAE ofrainrate(mm/day) within eachregion/branch; arithmeticmean of six900s branch losses gives equalregionandequalinitialscenario weight. Scorebranches separatelybeforeaveraging, never averagewet/drypredictionsfirst or pick beststart. Scenario weightsaredeclared,notprobabilities. Comparewithmeanofthreepairedr39losses. Regionaltradeoffsallowed; no unanimitygate.

No accuracyclaim froma smallregionalmean differencealone. Report daily surface area with positive liquid below273.15K as a liquid-only-physics limitation, without clipping or hiding those cells.

analysis.scope: Read-only analysis under fixed masks/calendar/objective. Pending/incomplete/invalid primary cases withhold pooled score. Three reused region/month pairs, fixed simulated laterals and initialization brackets are not annual/global validation; liquid-only and flat-terrain limitations retained.
